items.quote: For the message he declared by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the towns of Samaria will certainly come true.
items.contrast: The father’s stated reason—the certainty of the man of God’s prophecy—is distinguished from the incidental fact that he had just buried him.
items.reason: The opening “For” explicitly makes the prophecy’s certain fulfillment the reason for the burial request. The key captures that causal relation, and the stem clearly asks for it.
